tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Start here. Every league on the board now, with offer counts and available stats, plus which have history and graded results.

tools.name: get_projections
tools.description: The first place to get current PrizePicks lines, with goblin and demon tiers labeled. Filter by one league or comma-separated leagues (NBA,NFL,NHL), stat, player or team search, and tier (standard, goblin, demon). Exact league codes only. Optional start_after (inclusive) and start_before (exclusive)

tools.name: get_line_history
tools.description: Every recorded change to one projection, oldest first. Use an id from get_projections. Developer required. Free evaluation uses the fixed training-set sample.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Change feed across the board: new, changed, pulled and restored lines. Save next_cursor and pass it back to read only what moved since. This is the cheap way to stay current. Developer required. Free evaluation uses the fixed training-set sample.

tools.name: get_board_at
tools.description: The board as it stood at a past instant (as_of, ISO 8601 with a time zone). For backtests and point-in-time questions. Developer required. Free evaluation uses the fixed training-set sample.

tools.name: get_imported_lines
tools.description: Past lines supplied by third parties, not recorded by this API. Every row carries provenance. Empty until meta.available_datasets is above 0. Never present these as lines this API observed. Free plan: games from the last 7 days.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Lines graded against final box scores, NBA and the leagues in meta.leagues_graded: closing line, actual value, over, under, push or void. Developer required. Free evaluation uses the fixed training-set sample.

tools.name: get_hit_rates
tools.description: How often one player has gone over, per stat, across their last graded games. Free plan: the last 10 games, with per-game rows from the last 7 days.

tools.name: get_game_logs
tools.description: A player's box score line for each past game, newest first: minutes, opponent, home or away, and every stat. Use for recent form and for prop model features. Pass player_id (from get_projections or find_players), or player and league, with last for the most recent N games. For a whole season pass le

tools.name: get_team_stats
tools.description: A team's stats per game with the opponent's beside them, or group_by=season for per-game averages and totals. Needs league, one of meta.stats_leagues. Send team, or a season to read every team. Free plan: one team, its last 10 games.

tools.name: get_opponent_stats
tools.description: What a team gives up per game to opposing teams, or by=position for what each position records against it. Needs league, one of meta.stats_leagues. Send team, or a season to read every team. Set end_date to read it as of a past day. Free plan: one team, its last 10 games.

tools.name: get_training_set
tools.description: One flat row per graded line for building a prop model: opening and closing line, tier, opponent, home or away, rest days, minutes, actual value, result. Voids left out unless include_void=true. Page with cursor; save rows as you go rather than holding them in the conversation. Free plan: one page,

tools.name: compare_lines
tools.description: PrizePicks lines beside offered sportsbook prices for a league. Use it to see where a line differs from the market. Free plan: prices run 5 minutes behind, and as_of is off.

tools.name: get_live_sports
tools.description: Developer, Production or Scale: latest source-pushed game scores, period, clock and status. Optional league and source filters. Use source=prizepicks for PrizePicks game state; default is polymarket. These are game updates, not projection lines. Always report observed_at and meta.feed_connected; Pri

tools.name: get_stale_lines
tools.description: PrizePicks lines (NBA, NFL, NHL, before the game) where the BetRivers or Kalshi price for the same player and stat moved materially while the PrizePicks line stayed. Each row has the line, the book move in probability points, when it moved, how long the line has stayed since, and observed_at for bot

tools.name: get_trending
tools.description: Current lines by reported pick count, or with sort=change by the rise since a sample one to two windows back (change_since names it). The count is source-reported with an unverified definition: a popularity signal, not money or a pick recommendation. Most lines report no count. For screens and alert

tools.name: get_line_popularity
tools.description: The reported pick count of one line every 15 minutes, and its value at the start. Use an id from get_projections.

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: PrizePicks lines and book prices grouped by fixture. Needs fixture_id or league.

tools.name: find_players
tools.description: Stable player ids by name, league or team.

tools.name: get_fixtures
tools.description: Games with lines on the board, by league, date or status.

tools.name: get_fixture
tools.description: One fixture by id.

tools.name: get_injuries
tools.description: Current third-party injury reports for NBA, NFL, NHL and WNBA.

tools.name: get_payouts
tools.description: Standard PrizePicks payout tables with per-leg break-even rates.

tools.name: get_demo_projections
tools.description: Fictional sample rows in the live response shape, for trying the API without a key. Never present these as real lines.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find a player, league, guide or answer on prizepicksapi.com. Needs no key. Then call fetch with a result id. Use this when no API key is connected.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one search result: a player's current lines and recent graded results, a league summary, a guide or an answer. Needs no key. Quote the read time when you state a line.

tools.name: start_signup
tools.description: Starts getting a free API key. Say what data your user wants and what they want to do with it; ask them if you do not know, and do not guess. Returns a link for your user to approve in the browser. Show them the link and code, then call finish_signup.

tools.name: finish_signup
tools.description: Call with device_code from start_signup, every few seconds, until your user has approved. Returns the key once. Store it as an environment variable, never in a repo.

tools.name: complete_setup
tools.description: Required once per account before the data tools work. Say what data your user is looking for and what they want to do with it, in your own words. Ask your user if you do not already know; do not guess or make it up. Costs no quota. Leave out personal data.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Report data or a feature you needed and could not get, wrong data, or anything confusing. Be specific about league, stat, field and what you were trying to do. Optionally rate how well the last result served the task, 1 to 5; a rating alone is enough. Leave out personal data. Needs no key and costs

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "finish_signup" references sensitive artifacts (environment variable). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_changes · Private data: get_opponent_stats, search, start_signup, finish_signup · Public sink: get_team_stats, get_opponent_stats, send_feedback · Destructive: compare_lines.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_changes · Private data: get_opponent_stats, search, start_signup, finish_signup · Public sink: get_team_stats, get_opponent_stats, send_feedback · Destructive: compare_lines

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_live_sports" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Developer or Production: latest source-pushed game scores, period, clock and status. Optional league and source filters. Use source=prizepicks for PrizePicks game state; default is polymarket. These are game updates, not projection lines. Always report observed_at and meta.feed_connected; PrizePicks" → after: "Developer, Production or Scale: latest source-pushed game scores, period, clock and status. Always report observed_at and meta.feed_connected; Pri"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
